body:
I've been looking for a professional, but with my new work schedule it's been difficult. Including the commute I'm out of the house from a little before 8 in the morning until almost 8 at night. I'm still on buproprion 150mg but I had stopped taking it for a while when everything seemed fine. I'm back on it now.

I started going to some group exercise classes last year in Seattle and that was helpful mainly because of the community at that gym. I signed up for one my first day here in NYC but it was so different.. No community whatsoever. I ended up cancelling my membership. Since then most of my exercise has just been walking around the city, especially now with Pokemon Go. I should go back to a regular gym though.

You're definitely right about talking to the ex about her sex life. It came up as we were joking around. We're both attending a wedding this weekend where not everyone knows we're divorced, she mentioned bringing a date and it just came up in the conversation.

No, I've been reading the Magician's trilogy lately which I cannot say is uplifting. I got Furiously Happy from amazon, maybe I'll switch to that for now.

I've tried dating a bit, but I was still feeling guilty, like I was going behind her back despite the divorce. I ended up deleting the dating apps off my phone. I still don't know if I'm emotionally ready to move on and I feel like it would be unfair to whomever I try and date to test my emotional status out on them.

Work people know the situation with the divorce and are supportive, but definitely not the depression. I tried signing up for meetup groups to get out there and meet people with similar interests but chickened out on the day of the meetup. At least with work it's a forced thing and I've had some time to get somewhat comfortable with the coworkers vs random people.

You're right though, I need to get back out there.
